en.headline: AFCD lists eight farm and fishery tours from November
en.dek: Places are HK$300 each, for ages six and above, and can be booked only at a Tseung Kwan O fair on 10 and 11 October.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department has listed eight paid experiential tours under its leisure fishery and farm programme, with the first running on 7 November, according to the department's own page.

Each place costs HK$300 for adults and children. Groups are capped at about 20 to 25 people, and participants must be at least six. The department said registration is only on the spot at the "Leisure, Nature: Chill and Fun" fair at East Point City in Tseung Kwan O on 10 and 11 October. Enquiries go to the fisheries training and development unit on 3426 3231 or 6028 9856.

The 7 November tour meets at Tin Shui Wai station at 1:30pm for a pond visit and oyster workshop at Pak Nai, with a farm dinner, and returns at 7pm. The next day, a Tolo Harbour trip meets at Tai Po Market station at 9am, boards a leisure raft for a culture talk, cage-weaving demonstration and hand-line session, and ends at 2pm.

Later dates on the same list run through 27 December and include Pat Heung, the northeastern waters and Kat O, Aberdeen, a pearl raft at Tap Mun, Kwu Tung and Ta Kwu Ling. The department said meals on the tours use produce from the farms or rafts visited.

zh.headline: 漁護署下月起辦八個漁農體驗團
zh.dek: 每位300元，6歲或以上可參加，只限10月10及11日在將軍澳東港城博覽現場報名。
body: 漁農自然護理署在網頁列出八個休閒漁農業體驗團，首團在11月7日出發。
每位收費300元，大人小童同價，每團約20至25人，參加者須年滿6歲。署方指，報名只限10月10及11日在將軍澳東港城「漁農自然Chill好玩」博覽現場辦理。查詢可致電漁業及海洋護理分署培訓及發展組3426 3231或6028 9856。
11月7日的白泥團下午1時30分在天水圍站集合，到魚塘導賞並試開蠔，晚上7時解散，晚餐用漁場出品。翌日吐露港團上午9時在大埔墟站集合，登上休閒魚排，有養殖導賞、織魚籠示範及手釣，下午2時解散。
同表其後團期至12月27日，範圍包括八鄉、東北水域及吉澳、香港仔、塔門珍珠養殖、古洞及打鼓嶺。署方表示，團上膳食來自到訪魚場或農莊的出品。
